q1_issues.issue: The clause's two bare mass nouns are encoded inconsistently: `salt_bloom` rides in `Theme` as a bare class symbol while `mire_essence` is treated as a kind an instance variable must belong to (`(Member $mire mire_essence)`), so the premise binds only if some parse has minted an individual mire-essence witness — which the bare-class treatment of `salt_bloom` in the same rule shows is not the convention in use.

q2_gaps: "in winter" — a non-deictic recurring season as a time filler: the structured terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour, day-parts are the only licensed bare `Time` symbols, and seasons are covered only in their deictic forms (`last_spring`, `next_summer`)
notes: The rule shape is otherwise right — plain event variable in the trigger, Skolem-function response tied by `During`, surface-form `Manner slowly`, `Patient` for intransitive `burn`, and compound genera with the noun modifiers correctly left unexposed. Reading capitalized "the Keepers" as a named group (`Name` + `GroupOf`) is defensible under the mechanical casing cue.
